QuestInfo.name: Battle Hound Battleground
QuestInfo.1: Defeat #r100 Specter Battle Hounds#k in the #bSavage Dog Forest#k to break through enemy lines.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the Specter Battle Hounds!

0.0: Okay, ready. We think that the enemy Specter Battle Hound unit was a pivotal part of the attack on HQ.  unit played a big part in Specters' attack on the HQ. At least, that's what Edea says.\r\n
0.1: Stupid Battle Hounds! They sniffed us out and attacked us where it hurts! It's those Specter Tamers that are breeding the Specter Battle Hounds!\r\n
0.2: If you can take out maybe #r100#k of the #rSpecter Battle Hound#k forces, they won't be able to sniff us out like that again.\r\n
0.3: Oh, they'll have gathered in #bSavage Dog Forest#k by now. Oh, I wish I could see the looks on their ugly faces when they realize you're out there cleaning house!

yes.0: There's the spirit. I'd love to get out there and kick some of those critters around myself, but Edea's got me heading up the troops. Never get yourself promoted, kid.\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k

no.0: Apologies, your majesty. Perhaps I can find something more worthy of your time.\r\n

1.0: That was quick! You defeated all those Specter Battle Hounds already? Nicely done!\r\n

yes.0: HQ can breathe a little easier now that we've secured the route!\r\n
yes.1: The only thing now is to clear out some more of the stragglers and send out the boys to secure a good route. In the meantime, #bEdea#k has some work for you.\r\n

default.0: You still haven't knocked off the #rSpecter Battle Hounds#k. Stop loitering around here and get going!\r\n
